_doc: Settings for the Mac mini desk jobs (minihost/oid_desk). Ships in the desk snapshot and is re-pushed from the box via desk-state, so edit it here on the box.

vix._doc: Pluggable VIX source (Jeffrey 2026-10-10 default: one agent Robinhood read). agent_rh = market-data/latest/vix-agent.json written on the box by scripts/vix_agent_ingest.py from an RH get_index_quotes pull and pushed via desk-state. Alternatives: cboe_delayed (public 15-min delayed JSON), fred (VIXCLS daily close). fallbacks are tried in order when the primary is missing/stale. | 2026-10-14 (Jeffrey, arch review R4): primary = flashalpha_live (mini job vix-live, FlashAlpha /stockquote/VIX every 120 s, real-time index feed); then agent_rh (RH read), cboe_delayed (15-min delayed), fred (daily close, labelled fallback).

eia._doc: EIA API v2 weekly petroleum (WPSR). Needs EIA_API_KEY on the mini (free). Skipped cleanly without it.

edgar._doc: SEC requires a descriptive User-Agent with a contact email. The job refuses to run while it contains SET-ME.

marks._doc: oid_desk.marks: local collector quotes (fresh) + Alpaca SIP snapshots (prev close / fallback) -> RH-shaped equity file -> dashboard/live_refresh.py --equity-quotes-file --options-from-mini --skip-rebuild.

_alert_channels_doc: Extra alert channels for oid_desk.alerts (pluggable second channel). Empty until Jeffrey picks a phone push service. Spec: {name, type: json_webhook|ntfy, url, secret: <secret file name>, min_status: [...], enabled}.

short_borrow._doc: S5 short-interest/borrow archive (oid_desk.short_borrow). Daily on weekdays at/after due_et (ET). Append-only under data/short-borrow/.
